name: Brezno (Slovakia)
description: Six equal horizontal stripes of blue, blue, white, white, red and red, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature B-7/1991.
